evidence_quotes: On a mission to become one of the most modern courts in the nation, the Alabama Appellate Courts System (AACS) needed to digitize justice systems to accelerate secure and transparent proceedings.
AACS is in the process of migrating many of its on-premises operations to a more secure cloud environment on Microsoft Azure.
With this unified solution, justices, employees, and 6,000 outside attorneys benefit from remote access, more efficient operations, and improved security.

Modernizing technology to maintain a legacy of integrity The Alabama Appellate Courts System (AACS) includes three courts: the Supreme Court of Alabama, the Court of Civil Appeals, and the Court of Criminal Appeals, and has been in operation for more than 200 years.
